We’re so grateful for your continued love and support for Kittenwood! Your excitement and kind reviews inspire us to keep creating games filled with magic, cats, and hidden treasures.

[h2]Spring Sale is Here![/h2]

The Steam Spring Sale has arrived, and if you’re looking to complete your collection, our Gemcraft’s Hidden Cat Bundle is available at a big discount! This bundle includes Kittenwood, Kittenbay, and Hidden Cat Memories, offering you more hidden object adventures filled with adorable felines.

store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

We’re thrilled to announce Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game, launching in Q2 2025! This new adventure is a fresh take on our love for cozy, spot the difference gameplay, featuring stunning artwork made by Bleeding Moon Studio.

Your wishlists mean the world to us and help us bring Mermeows to even more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457460/Mermeows_Chill_Cat_Mermaids/

[h2]More Hidden Cat Games in the Works![/h2]

[h2]We’d Love to Hear From You![/h2]

If you’ve enjoyed Kittenwood, we’d be incredibly grateful if you could leave us a review! Your feedback helps us grow and introduces our games to new players who love hidden object adventures just like you.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. 

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: Goldenpaw Unleashes Magical Updates and New Adventures!

[b]🌈✨ Special Celebration Announcement from Goldenpaw! ✨🌈[/b]

Greetings, valiant explorers and cherished dreamers of Kittenwood and beyond! It’s your ageless guardian, Goldenpaw, tail swishing with anticipation and whiskers brimming with news. Are you ready to dive into a celebration woven with magic and memories? Let’s embark on this enchanting journey together!

🎉 Update 1.2.0 - A New Dawn for Interaction:

Unfurl your maps and ready your wits, for we’ve transformed your experience in our mystical realms! With our latest update 1.2.0, all humans in Kittenwood have found their voices. Yes, every character you meet can now speak, adding a layer of interaction as rich as the tales of old.

More you can read here : https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2464090/view/4200244961720950236?l=english

🌟 Special Offer - Celebrate with Us!

In celebration of these wondrous updates, we’re thrilled to offer a 20% discount on Kittenwood until the 30th of April! Don’t miss this chance to explore my beloved town at a price as enchanting as the adventures that await.

🎮 Sneak Peek - The Upcoming Enchantments:

Whispering winds carry tales of not one, but two new games under construction, each set to enchant in its unique way.

Firstly, venture into the ethereal realm of Kittynawa with our upcoming soon title "Pawsome Hidden Cats." Here, each corner of the world brims with mystery and magic, waiting for you to unveil its secrets through intricate hidden object challenges. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841060/Pawsome_Hidden_Cats__Kittynawa/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277168/1fb7e32336666d6bae24163dd9144889351ee24e.png[/img]

So, mark your calendars and prepare your hearts for adventures that promise to be both nostalgic and groundbreaking. The lands of Kittenwood and the new horizons of Kittynawa are calling—will you answer?

With twinkling eyes and a heart brimming with excitement,

notes.title: Major Update Announcement - Goldenpaw Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we're thrilled to bring you a major update that has been carefully crafted to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[b]Final Challenge Revamped 🏆[/b]

[b]• Stress-Free Gameplay: [/b]We've done away with the nerve-wracking countdown. Now, you can take on the final challenge at your own pace. But if you're up for a time challenge, we still track your best time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277168/cef0bc24055b68a29f248e110765ebb190e13e17.png[/img]

[b]• Unlimited Replays:[/b] You can now replay the final challenge as many times as you like. Just use the same summoning mechanic as you did the first time.
[b]• Pause & Play:[/b] Taking a quick break? Pause the final challenge either through the options menu or by simply pressing 'P'.

[b]Graphics & Layout Improvements 🎨[/b]

[b]• Smooth Moves:[/b] We've made all camera movements smoother for an even more immersive experience.
[b]• Main Menu Makeover:[/b] We've revamped our main menu layout, making it more intuitive and visually appealing.
[b]• Surprise!:[/b] Keep an eye out for the clickable surprises we've hidden in the main menu. Can you find them all?

[b]Quality of Life Enhancements ✨[/b]

[b]• Readability Boost: [/b]We've refined some of the in-game texts for clarity.
[b]• Bug Busters:[/b] As always, we've swatted a few minor bugs to make sure your gameplay remains smooth and glitch-free.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. Dive in, explore the updates, and let us know what you think.

Enjoy the game! 🎮🌟
